next.reason: 1985 refuses a WRITE where 'Record-name-1 and identifier-1 ... refer to the same storage area'. 2023 has no such syntax rule: §2023:14.9.51.4 GR5 (NOTE 1) applies 14.6.10 and the MOVE rules 'to any cases in which the storage area identified by identifier-1 and the record area associated with record-name-1 share any part'; §2023:14.6.10 GR2 (same entry: as if no overlap) and §2023:14.6.10 GR1 (otherwise undefined) give the result; §2023:14.9.51.4 GR9 contemplates identifier-1 within the file's record descriptions. Refusal became acceptance; no exception condition.
